Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class DeliveryService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.DeliveryService
All Implemented Interfaces:
DeliverNewsletterUseCase, ManageSubscribersUseCase
public class DeliveryService extends Object implements ManageSubscribersUseCase, DeliverNewsletterUseCase
Application service that implements subscriber lifecycle management.

Orchestrates the subscriber domain operations — add, remove, list — by coordinating through SubscriberPort. All business rules live here: duplicate detection before adding, existence check before removing.

This class carries no Spring annotations; AppConfig wires it as a @Bean so the application layer stays framework-free and is trivially testable with plain Mockito, no Spring context required.

Slice 3c will add scheduling support via NewsletterGenerationScheduler.

  • Method Details

    • deliver

      public int deliver(String runId)
      Delivers the newsletter run identified by runId to all active subscribers.

      Retrieves the run via NewsletterRunPort (throws RunNotFoundException if absent), collects all active subscribers, dispatches via NewsletterDeliveryPort, then updates the run status to NewsletterRunStatus.SENT.

      If there are no active subscribers the delivery is skipped and the run status is left unchanged; a warning is logged.

      Specified by:
      deliver in interface DeliverNewsletterUseCase
      Parameters:
      runId - The ID of the newsletter run to deliver.
      Returns:
      the total number of recipients the newsletter was sent to.

      public void removeSubscriber(String email)
      Removes an existing subscriber by email.
